title: Re-verify every screening unit through the bubblewrap grade
body:
Source: t-mm01kck lane. Grading now runs inside bubblewrap (read-only HOME, offline test phase). Four units, one per install family (go t-fd481gz, pnpm t-1zp9219, python t-ubnq9ps, npm t-1hecgls), kept their recorded verdicts under the sandbox; the other units were not re-run.
Outcome: every verified unit in evals/units/screening-manifest.json is re-verified through the sandbox on a manifest copy, and any unit whose verdict flips is fixed (write target moved into the cache) or dropped from the screen.
Proof: a log of node evals/units/screening.ts verify on a cleared manifest copy whose verdicts equal the committed ones, with the flipped ids listed.
